summary: Support employees with endpoint, identity and device incidents, maintain asset records and resolve Jira Service Management requests. Configure corporate computers/devices and support secure access.
requirements: Required: practical Windows 10/11, macOS and Microsoft 365 knowledge, communication, collaborative troubleshooting and interest in ITSM and automation. Preferred: prior practical exposure (including personal projects/internships) to IdP/MDM or Zero Trust, AWS Cloud Practitioner, event AV and certifications such as CompTIA A+ or ITIL. Cloud operations are explicitly outside the role scope. Preferred also includes scripting, RMM monitoring, knowledge bases and self-service/chatbot flows; mentoring less-experienced colleagues is expected.
compensation: Not disclosed in the public posting.
conditions: The employer lists on-site work from São Paulo. Country eligibility is limited to the listed location, not generalized worldwide. Original publication is corroborated by datePosted in the public employer-hosted JobPosting data, not just the API creation timestamp. Visa sponsorship or international relocation is not disclosed; inclusion is based on the stated Brazil/LATAM work location. The public workplace field is on-site in São Paulo; remote troubleshooting within the duties does not make the job remote.
